definitions.name: User rack PC · 1U
definitions.source: User-measured: 15 in / 381 mm from mounting-ear contact plane to rear fascia; chassis 17 in / 431.8 mm wide, 19 in / 482.6 mm across ears. User-confirmed 1U; physical height 43 mm is PROVISIONAL, exact height to follow. Ports are editable photo-plane estimates from IMG_9051.JPG / IMG_9058.JPG, with rear checked against IMG_9057.JPG. Ear thickness unknown (2 mm preview), ear holes, socket sizes/recess, handles and side-stud envelopes are provisional. Manufacturer/model, mass, support/rail kit and load rating unknown. Direct mounting describes the ear datum, not a support certification. User annotated rear photo confirms DisplayPort above HDMI, five USB 2.0 ports, one USB 3.0 port and 1G Ethernet. Port centres remain photo estimates. See docs/user-pc-reference.md.

definitions.name: Adjustable lacing bar · middle hole
definitions.source: User requested one middle-hole screw per side, a 150 mm inward return and a crossbar. Generic editable example: reach to inside face 150 mm; 6 × 8 mm bar, 14 mm tabs and 2 mm ears are provisional. No load rating or manufacturer compatibility is established.

settings.notes: Generic middle-hole lacing bars with 150 mm clear inward reach (156 mm overall with the provisional 6 mm crossbar). Profile/tab dimensions and rack construction are illustrative. Front/rear placement examples; ordinary surface wiring guides stay in world space when hardware moves.
